games.name: A Quiet Place: Deadzone (Pre-Alpha)
games.desc:
The earth has been overrun by deadly extraterrestrial creatures. Using their unimaginably good hearing, these aliens are able to hunt down and silence anyone and anything that makes noise. The United States Government has designated the entirety of the Northeastern United States as a deadzone, where no one has been able to establish contact. In your hometown of Cold Spring, New York, your only hope of survival is to stay silent. 

During this phase, everything that is currently in-game is subject to change. Any gamepasses or products that currently exist are not necessarily permanent. Purchase at your own risk (Expect accomodations of some kind).

games.name: Project Lazarus: 💀 ZOMBIES 💀
games.desc:
Survive the endless waves of zombie hordes in this cooperative shooter. Earn points by killing zombies and repairing barricades. Get better weapons and open up new areas before the undead overrun you.

Project Lazarus: Zombies is the spiritual successor to my old zombies game. Inspired by classic wave-based Call of Duty Zombies.

Controls:
Interact - [F] / Hold [Button X]
Fire - [Left Mouse Button] / [Right Trigger]
Aim Down Sights - [Q] / [Right Mouse Button] / [Left Trigger]
Reload - [R] / [Button X]
Switch Weapon - [1], [2], [3], [Scroll Wheel] / [Button Y], [Button B]
Sprint - Hold [Left Shift] / [Left Stick Button]
Knife - [V] / [Right Stick Button]
Inspect - [B] / [DPad Left]
Settings - [P] / [DPad Down]
Scoreboard - [Tab] / [DPad Right]

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, Xbox, & PlayStation.
